data.text: Tap, only on an action in which you do not move: a point-buy on the stat you are best at that has no Druid stone on this tile yet and — only if that roll succeeds — a second one on the next best. Each success raises a Druid stone (a mapped Healing Orb / obelisk) here as a tile bonus of that stat's element. Whoever stands on it adds it to that stat (and to life, by the Σ/10 rule). One stone per stat; with stones standing on every free pick, a roll tries to beat the lowest one. A failed first roll still taps the card.

cat: ] class druid: I move this action — the card stays untapped
